post.caption: Gibson's SG hid its knobs under diamonds. In 2015, a Hong Kong jeweler covered a Gibson SG in diamonds. The guitar carries 11,441 diamonds, over 400 carats in all. Its gold is 1.6 kilograms of 18-karat white gold. A team of 68 artisans built it for Aaron Shum's brand, Coronet. The volume and tone knobs sit hidden under the diamonds. Only the plain chrome hardware shows. At Baselworld in March 2015, Guinness named it the most valuable guitar. Next year, that jeweler covered a Fender bass in 16,033 gems. Jermaine Jackson performed with it at Baselworld. Photo: Jeff Meyer, CC BY 2.0. Photo: Michael Gaylard, CC BY 2.0.
